transcript.text: Hi everyone. Before we finalize this policy, I need to flag a couple of things from this month's invoice reconciliation that affect the draft. The reserved-capacity credits for this cluster are expiring this quarter, which means spot instances aren't viable for these jobs right now. I also need to adjust the monthly spending cap — it should be $14,000, not $18,000. I haven't posted the full reconciliation note in the infrastructure review thread yet, but I wanted to surface these two items now so we can correct the draft before Riley approves.

I haven't opened the compliance ticket for this policy yet, but these are hard requirements that need to be corrected before Riley approves.
